'''House Stonebear''' is the house of '''honor''': power rests on always, unfailingly keeping one's word. In a harsh, isolated corner of the realm, honor is the one currency that cannot be counterfeited. Stonebear are the realm's oath-witnesses, mediators, hostage-keepers, and judges — the house called upon when no one else can be trusted.

== Philosophy and reputation ==
''"Say not 'I'll try.' Say 'yes' or 'no.'"'' Stonebear chooses, again and again, to lose rather than become what it despises — admired by all, exploited by many, seldom loved. In the last decade sharper houses have learned to weaponize the house's literalism, and Stonebear has paid, every time, rather than bend. Every treaty in the realm is worth more because Stonebear exists; the house is visibly poorer each year for it.

== Customs ==
* '''[[Guest-right]]''' — the house's most sacred custom: whoever has eaten at your table is absolutely protected, even an enemy. The door of the Guest Hall cannot be barred.
* '''The Oath-Stone''' — a standing stone where oaths are sworn. People say it "remembers" whoever breaks their word; the stone remembers nothing — people remember ''through'' the stone.
* '''The Wall of Shame''' — oathbreakers' names are carved forever, displayed rather than hidden. The oldest line is '''nameless''', and older than all the others.

== The seat ==
[[Oath-hold]] is a gray-stone fortress hewn into the mountainside at the northeastern foot of [[the Silent Mountains]] — harsh, low, built of the same stone it guards.

== Members (396 A.U.) ==
* '''[[Reverend Torvald]]''' (~59), head of house — the realm's most sought-after oath-witness, entirely at peace with what his word costs.
* '''[[Rurik Stonebear]]''' (~30), heir — reads every sworn thing aloud, word for word, hunting for honest space inside the letter.
* '''[[Oathmother Hild]]''' (~76) — keeper of the rite at the nameless line; the only living person who knows the words.
* '''[[Ser Alba]]''' (~44), sword-hand — the house's most reasonable voice for bending, and the only Stonebear who has personally paid for not bending.
